newsitem.title: USA: Cemig buyers to pay for stake in two parts.
newsitem.headline: Cemig buyers to pay for stake in two parts.

text.p: The AES Corp and its consortium partners, Southern Co and the Opportunity Fund, a Brazilian investment fund, will pay the $1.056 billion purchase price for a stake in Brazilian utility Cemig in two installments.
AES said in a statement that the purchase price would be paid in early June 1997 and in 1998.
The consortium bought 14.41 percent of Cemig (Companhia Energetica de Minas Gerais) an integrated electric utility located in the Brazilian state of Minas Gerais.
It added that the consortium had the right to appoint the chief operating officer and will share control of Cemig with the state government of Minas Gerais.
